ALL THREE PANELS: add a small South Korean Taegeukgi flag cloth patch to the wearer's anatomical RIGHT UPPER ARM, on outer SIDE of shoulder/sleeve immediately below shoulder seam. Flag patch: white 3:2 rectangle, red-top blue-bottom Taegeuk circle at center, four black trigram groups in corners, dark stitched border, follow sleeve perspective. Visible beside upper chest on outer sleeve, NOT on top of shoulder. No giant flag.

Apply details consistently to all three poses. Shoulder epaulettes sit on TOP slope of shoulder from collar toward outer shoulder; flag sits on SIDE of right sleeve below that, distinct areas. Retain 1536x1024 transparent PNG, three equal 512px-wide cells, no labels/text/watermark/background. True alpha outside sprites. Preserve all personality expressions. Keep each complete sprite inside own cell without crossing x=512 or x=1024. Do not change any facial details.
